name: Aso Rock
description: Aso Rock is one of Abuja's most recognizable natural landmarks. This massive rock formation overlooks important government institutions and contributes to the city's distinctive landscape.
imageAlt: Aso Rock rising above the Abuja landscape

name: National Mosque
address: Independence Avenue, Central Business District, Abuja
description: The Nigerian National Mosque is a remarkable architectural landmark in Abuja. Its impressive golden dome and elegant minarets make it one of the city's most recognizable religious buildings.
imageAlt: The Nigerian National Mosque in Abuja

name: National Christian Centre
description: The National Christian Centre is an important religious and architectural landmark. Its distinctive design and central location make it a notable feature of Abuja.
imageAlt: The National Christian Centre building in Abuja

name: Millennium Park
description: Millennium Park is one of Abuja's major public green spaces. Visitors enjoy its landscaped gardens, walking areas, and peaceful outdoor environment.
imageAlt: Green landscaped gardens at Millennium Park Abuja

name: Jabi Lake
description: Jabi Lake is a popular recreational destination in Abuja. The surrounding area offers opportunities for relaxation, outdoor activities, and enjoying scenic waterfront views.
imageAlt: Scenic view of Jabi Lake in Abuja

name: Arts and Crafts Village
description: Abuja Arts and Crafts Village showcases Nigerian creativity and traditional craftsmanship. Visitors can explore handmade artwork, sculptures, textiles, and cultural souvenirs.
imageAlt: Traditional Nigerian artworks and crafts at Abuja Arts and Crafts Village

name: Moshood Abiola National Stadium
address: National Stadium Complex, Airport Road, Abuja, Nigeria
description: The Moshood Abiola National Stadium is a major sporting facility in Nigeria's capital. It hosts sporting competitions and other major public events.
imageAlt: Moshood Abiola National Stadium in Abuja

name: Zuma Rock
address: Madalla, Suleja, Niger State, near Abuja
description: Zuma Rock is an impressive natural landmark located near Abuja along the Abuja-Kaduna expressway. Its striking appearance makes it one of the most recognizable natural attractions in the region.
imageAlt: The impressive Zuma Rock near Abuja

name: Gurara Falls
description: Gurara Falls is a beautiful natural waterfall surrounded by lush greenery. It is a popular destination for visitors seeking scenic views, photography and outdoor adventures.
imageAlt: Water cascading over the rocky landscape at Gurara Falls
